column1: # The data segment distributed (D38, change 3a): every top-level member of the 1987 GameData, and where it lives now.
# Tools/GenerateGameData.py reads this beside Design/Symbols.tsv; Tools/GenerateTables.py and Tools/CompareStateValues.py read it.
#   member   the member's name, a row of Design/Symbols.tsv, or a gap the game uses (gapXXXX, named for its offset)
#   address  its 1987 offset in the data segment, where the reference's image holds its first value
#              a subsystem    the one subsystem that writes it: its struct, <Subsystem>State, in GameData (GameData::flight)
#              a shared group several subsystems write it: PlayerShip, Messages, Audio, Menus, Disk, Drawing, Commander,
#              constant       nothing writes it: a constexpr table of the subsystem that reads it (Tools/GenerateTables.py)
#              unused         nothing reads it: kept in UnusedState for change 3b, which removes it with the turn probe
#   readers  the subsystems (GameLogic/<Subsystem>.cpp) that read it, by member, by raw offset or as part of a text
#   writers  the subsystems that write it
#   notes    where the static scan was wrong, and why a member is where it is
# A gap not listed is dropped: no byte of it is in the state, and a read of it by the original's address finds the reference's
# image (GameState). Members read as one text or span stay together, in their 1987 order. Measured on 6252eec: a static scan of
# GameLogic/, confirmed in the code, and the bytes the corpus and the tests read and write.
